Scope and important findings

All 716 images were visually reviewed. This catalogue indexes sheets and files; it does not claim a named entry for every frame, tile or object inside a mixed sheet. Gameplay roles are proposals. Suggested cell sizes need validation before use in a runtime atlas.

Use the six matching hero appearances across modern action packs. Additional Animations supplies roll, hit, push/pull and swim. Dedicated boomerang-throw strips exist for the two legacy appearances; adapting the modern throw-item poses is an implementation choice.

Keep New Style and Old Style terrain coherent within a region. Exclude baked headers in NPC/enemy sheets. Some legacy strips, the house update and boss tongue sheet require explicit rectangles. A dedicated hero death sheet and bomb explosion sheet were not identified.
